tools.name: start_thread
tools.description: Start a private thread and atomically send its first message. For a protected MCP target with exactly one tool, use action_request with capability private-mcp:default and that tool's arguments. Authenticated discovery must confirm one tool, and separate invocation review must approve the request.

operationId.description: Exact executable operation identifier returned by Search or get_thread.

arguments.description: Arguments for that operation, matching its advertised input schema. Never include credentials or payment details.

account.description: Optional saved external-account reference. This is an opaque Darwin ID, never a token or secret.

discoveryPreflight.description: Exact no-effect protected discovery reference. Connection alone never starts an action.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Append one typed event to an authorized thread. Use message for ordinary text; action_request for one advertised capability; action_confirmation for the exact proposed external effect; approval_confirmation with decision allow or deny for one additional permission; completion_confirmation to accept a result without authorizing a new effect; or cancellation_request to ask the provider to cancel one operation. Exact request and operation IDs must come from get_thread. Plain text never grants authority, a cancellation request is not confirmed cancellation, and durable acceptance is not remote completion.

request.description: Exact pending input request returned by get_thread.

arguments.description: Requested information matching that request schema. This continues the same operation; it is not a new action.

messageType.description: Ordinary conversation content with no approval authority.

messageContent.description: Non-empty text. Plain text never approves an action, permission, completion, cancellation, or payment.

messageType.description: Request execution of one exact advertised operation.

operationId.description: Exact executable operation identifier returned by Search or get_thread.

arguments.description: Arguments for that operation, matching its advertised input schema. Never include credentials or payment details.

account.description: Optional saved external-account reference. This is an opaque Darwin ID, never a token or secret.

messageContent.description: Object with the exact operationId and schema-valid arguments; use account only as an opaque saved-account reference.

messageType.description: Authorize the exact proposed external effect referenced by request.

request.description: Exact immutable request identifier returned by get_thread.

messageContent.description: Object containing only the exact action request ID returned by get_thread. It does not authorize later changes.

messageType.description: Allow or deny one additional permission request after reviewing it.

request.description: Exact immutable approval request identifier returned by get_thread.

decision.description: Approval decision: allow authorizes only the referenced request; deny rejects only that request. Neither value substitutes for another request type.

messageContent.description: Object with the exact approval request ID and decision allow or deny. Plain text cannot replace this confirmation.

messageType.description: Record acceptance of a presented result; this never authorizes a new external effect.

request.description: Exact immutable request identifier returned by get_thread.

messageContent.description: Object containing only the exact completion request ID returned by get_thread.

messageType.description: Ask the provider to cancel one exact operation; the request alone does not prove cancellation.

actionId.description: Exact in-flight action identifier returned by get_thread whose cancellation should be requested.

messageContent.description: Object containing only the exact operation ID. Wait for provider-confirmed cancellation in get_thread.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Read a thread, optionally waiting for new events.

audience.description: Who consumes this response. Controls presentation only; never identity, permissions, or approval.

thread.description: Exact owner-scoped thread identifier to read.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

wait.description: Wait briefly for new thread events when none are currently available.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return, from 1 to 100.

question.description: One focused research question in 10-18 words.

question.description: A concise decision question in 4-10 words, not a restatement of the entire brief.

basis.description: State whether these are proposed approaches, supplied facts, or verified evidence. Never invent product features or scores.

label.description: Item name only. Never duplicate quantities, currency amounts or unit costs in this label; the user can edit those independently.

assumptions.description: Explicitly identify any assumed prices, quantities and currency. These are editable estimates, not provider quotes.

intent.description: A concrete next-step instruction in plain language. Never an opaque command token such as confirm_criteria.

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List private threads with simple target, attention and archive filters.

targetAgent.description: Filter history to threads with this target agent identifier.

needsAttention.description: Filter by whether a thread needs attention from the caller.

archived.description: Filter by archived state; omit to use the default history view.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return, from 1 to 100.
